name: ZenPay Editor
description: Public browser-based code/content editor built on LiveCodes.io framework, VS Code-style client interface.
summary: Client-side code playground (forked from LiveCodes) supporting 90+ languages/frameworks with Monaco editor, WebWorker-based compilation, npm ecosystem SDK for embedding, 40+ UI languages, real-time broadcast/sync, and self-hosted deployment via Docker or Cloudflare Pages.
notes: Server subdirectory uses Express + Socket.IO + Valkey for share/broadcast features
